reason_said: several_projects
the evidence of more than one project holds here and none outranks the others
one_witness
one witness names it here, and one alone does not join
content_only
only the folder's name and files match it, which do not join alone
a3_history_join
this repository holds its history, and under membership.strict a join resting on history asks
token_shared_no_commit
this checkout carries the checkout token of a live checkout with which it has no commit in common (a template's sibling, or a planted token), so the token is not evidence of the project
file_names_other_history
its project file names one project while it holds the commits of another and none of the named one's
boundary
its project file names a project of another boundary
file_contradiction
its project file names another project than the checkout's own
remote_diverged
its remote changed while the project elsewhere still names the old remote
subproject_contradiction
a project file below the checkout's root names a project that is not part of the project around that folder, and the folder is treated as the project around it until answered
duplicate_checkout

this checkout is a second record of a git directory another machine shares, registered by a sighting that did not read that machine's re-mint of the token as the first record's, while the first record is in the first project named; what was written here since stays in this checkout's project until answered
legacy_no_live_checkout
the records of a project whose folder is gone may belong to it: this repository holds some of their recorded commits
unresolved_location
records written at a folder that could not be read may belong to it
import_one_witness
an imported project has one witness here, and one alone does not join
import_contradiction
an imported project's file names one project here while another holds its commits
import_several_projects
an imported project's evidence names more than one project here
reason_unnamed: a reason this version does not name
words: holds its commits rewritten (same authors, dates and messages)
